name: King's Gambit
description: 2.f4 offers a pawn to open the f-file and build a big centre: sharp, attacking chess.

lines.name: Kieseritzky (3…g5)

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: h4 attacks g5 before Black can defend it with …h6 or …Bg7.
notes.8: Ne5: the knight jumps forward, eyeing g4 and f7.

6.Bc4: …g4! hits the f3 knight; h4 first stops this.

lines.summary: Against 3…g5, hit the pawn chain with h4; after …g4, jump to e5 with the knight.

lines.name: Kieseritzky: 5…h5

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: h4 attacks g5 before Black can defend it with …h6 or …Bg7.
notes.8: Ne5: the knight jumps forward, eyeing g4 and f7.
notes.10: Bc4 aims at f7, the weakest point in Black's camp.
notes.12: d4 opens the c1 bishop to win back f4.

6.Bc4: …g4! hits the f3 knight; h4 first stops this.

lines.summary: Against …h5, aim the bishop at f7 with Bc4, then d4 to win back the f4 pawn.

lines.name: Kieseritzky: 5…d6

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: h4 attacks g5 before Black can defend it with …h6 or …Bg7.
notes.8: Ne5: the knight jumps forward, eyeing g4 and f7.
notes.10: Nxg4 wins a pawn back; d4 and Bxf4 come next.

6.Bc4: …g4! hits the f3 knight; h4 first stops this.

lines.summary: When …d6 kicks the knight, take on g4 and then win back f4 with d4 and Bxf4.

lines.name: 3…d6

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: d4 takes the centre; the c1 bishop now eyes f4.

lines.summary: Against 3…d6, take the centre with d4 and aim to win back f4.

lines.name: 3…d6 4…g5

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: d4 takes the centre; the c1 bishop now eyes f4.
notes.8: h4 hits the g5 pawn, which holds f4.
notes.10: Ng1 steps back: the knight goes to e2 and helps win back f4.

8.Bc4: …g4! hits the f3 knight; h4 first stops this.

lines.summary: When Black holds f4 with …g5, break with h4; after …g4, the knight drops back and comes again via e2.

lines.name: 3…Nc6

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: d4 takes the centre and opens the c1 bishop.

lines.summary: Against 3…Nc6, take the centre with d4 at once.

lines.name: 3…Nc6 4…d5

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: d4 takes the centre and opens the c1 bishop.
notes.8: exd5 opens the e-file while Black's king is still in the centre.
notes.10: Nc3 develops with tempo on the black queen.

8.e5: …g5! keeps the extra pawn; exd5 first opens lines.

lines.summary: When Black hits back with …d5, take on d5 and develop Nc3 with tempo.

lines.name: Cunningham (3…Be7)

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.8: Kf1: the king is safe enough, and d4 and Bxf4 come next.

lines.summary: When the bishop checks on h4, step aside with Kf1; then d4 and win back f4.

lines.name: Modern (3…d5)

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: exd5 opens the e-file; the black queen is drawn into the centre.
notes.8: Nc3 develops with tempo on the black queen.

lines.summary: Against …d5, take on d5 and develop Nc3 with tempo on the queen.

lines.name: Schallopp (3…Nf6)

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 covers h4 against …Qh4+ and prepares d4.
notes.6: e5 kicks the knight away from the centre.
notes.8: d4 builds the centre; the h5 knight is out of play.

lines.summary: Against …Nf6, push e5 and d4: the black knight ends up on the edge.

lines.name: 2…Nc6

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.4: Nf3 develops and covers h4 against …Qh4+.
notes.6: Bc4 aims at f7; castling and d3 come next.

lines.summary: Against 2…Nc6, develop Nf3 and Bc4, then castle and open the f-file.

lines.name: 2…d6 3…Bg4

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.6: h3 asks the bishop at once.
notes.8: Qxf3: White has the two bishops and an active queen.

lines.summary: Against the early pin, play h3: White gets the bishop pair.

lines.name: Falkbeer (2…d5)

notes.2: f4 offers a pawn to pull the e5 pawn away and open the f-file.
notes.6: d3 hits the e4 pawn at once, before Black can support it.

lines.summary: Against the Falkbeer, take on d5 and hit the e4 pawn with d3.
